title: Still tying the turban as court closes
literal_meaning: While tying the turban, the court closes.
explanation: The repeated tying phrase keeps preparation in progress while the court closes. The dictionary places the line under an office or court stopping work, not dismissal from a job. Our reading notices an opportunity ending before preparation finishes. The line does not say why the person took time, identify their role, or establish a particular court schedule.
meaning_odia: ପାଗ ବାନ୍ଧିବା ଚାଲିଥିବା ବେଳେ କଚିରି ବନ୍ଦ ହୁଏ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି କଚିରିର କାମ ବନ୍ଦ ହେବା ଅର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଅଛି, ଚାକିରିରୁ ବାହାରିବା ଅର୍ଥରେ ନୁହେଁ। ଆମ ପାଠରେ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି ସରିବା ଆଗରୁ ସୁଯୋଗ ସରିଯାଏ। କାହିଁକି ସମୟ ଲାଗିଲା, ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କ ପଦ କଣ ବା କଚିରିର ସମୟସୂଚୀ କିପରି—ଉତ୍ସ ତାହା କହେନାହିଁ।
english_summary: Our reading contrasts unfinished preparation with a closing opportunity.
odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠରେ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି ଅସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ, ସୁଯୋଗ କିନ୍ତୁ ସରିଲାଣି।
usage_example: Original imagined example: ଜଣେ ଫର୍ମଟି ସଜାଉଥିବା ବେଳେ ଆବେଦନ ସମୟ ସରିଗଲା। ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଥର ପାଇଁ ସେ ଆଗୁଆ ତାରିଖ ଲେଖିରଖିଲେ। / Someone misses an application deadline while arranging the form, then plans ahead for the next one. This scene is invented.
cultural_context: The turban and court remain the source image. No community identity, dress requirement, historical incident or deliberate procrastination is established; the modern deadline application is editorial.
